independence_note: Reviewer did not implement these six repairs or the gzip wire change, but previously implemented session projection and model verification portions of W14. This is a scoped repair review, not independent W14 card acceptance.

scope.method: Read-only source tracing followed by seven existing targeted regressions against the current actual Mu bundle. Tests use loopback provider and explicit workspace authority fixture ports; actual SDK and Windows sandbox execute.

evidence: client_protocol.go:1073 binds target to current session run; 1101-1117 checks current Owner and performs canonical cancelRun plus typed journal in one command transaction.
runtime_coordinator_windows.go:562-583 observes committed cancellation/epoch revocation every 200ms and cancels broker context and bridge.

TestClientCancelChangesCanonicalRun proves canonical state, revision and idempotency. TestRuntimeMuTypedCancelStopsTransport proves one provider request, inflight HTTP stopped within the test bound, and actual worker termination.
findings.qualification: Cancellation of an already dispatched provider operation may retain UNKNOWN cost/effect facts; this repair does not assert provider-side rollback or automatic terminal settlement without those facts.

evidence: runtime_tools_windows.go:114-133 distinguishes proven pre-dispatch/refused effects from uncertain outcomes; recordNotAppliedEffect persists a scoped zero-cost HOST_PRE_EFFECT_REFUSAL witness.
Host read/validation, write pre-mutation, and check pre-launch boundaries explicitly classify NOT_APPLIED. Mutation/launch errors remain uncertain.
worker.mjs:92-96 explicitly rejects the removed waiter before propagating fatal acknowledgement, avoiding a stranded promise.
TestRuntimeMuToolRefusalAllowsNextTurn proves NOT_APPLIED, settled FAILED, no automatic retry, and acceptance of the next explicit finite session turn.
runtimeFactMaxBytes = 4 MiB + 128 KiB is checked by writeRuntimeFact, recoverEffects and ingestEffectFact against encoded bytes.
TOOL host evidence has its own 4 MiB encoded limit and host_tool_evidence_hash verified before replay or settlement.
TestRuntimeMuSessionToolAndIndependentAcceptance includes recovery of a 160 KiB evidence fact and evidence-hash tamper rejection.
findings.qualification: Large-evidence regression exercises the durable fact replay path with synthetic evidence; it does not claim a new real run_check crash or a full 4 MiB manifest test.

evidence: ingestEffectFact validates inner key/run/epoch and CONFIRMED or NOT_APPLIED state before the replay fast path and budget mutation.

W14 TOOL binds host_tool to request.name and hashes canonical payload; MODEL requires raw SSE identity/hash, transport shape, bounded complete stream, and unknown actual cost. NOT_APPLIED requires a zero-cost undispatched host witness.
Existing integration regression rejects altered run, epoch, state, response hash, evidence hash and host tool even when replaying an already settled effect.
findings.qualification: Legacy non-MODEL/non-TOOL HTTP receipts retain their raw transport hash semantics; this review does not claim a new canonical payload hash retrofit to that branch.

evidence: Host read result stores text once, computes UTF-8-safe page ends by encoded result size under 56 KiB, and reports truthful next_offset/truncated metadata.
TestRuntimeToolReadPagesEncodedTextWithinBridgeFrame reconstructs multibyte and escaped contents across bounded pages. The broker still enforces the complete 64 KiB frame limit.
session.attach permits current-client reacquisition after prior runtime settlement, uses HandoffEpoch CAS, renews lease_expires_at, and publishes the new writer generation.
TestClientSameWriterRenewsExpiredLease verifies same client gets epoch 2 with future expiry and a stale revision claim is rejected.
findings.qualification: Renewal reuses the existing attach generation rotation and CLIENT_HANDOFF event even when previous and target client IDs match; this is an authenticated reacquisition, not a new client identity.

evidence: runtimeEffectWireReply is shared by initial MODEL delivery and CONFIRMED replay; original SSE and its hash remain in durable receipts.
Worker requires gzip+base64, canonical base64, bounded 2 MiB gunzip output, SHA-256 match and valid UTF-8 before constructing the SDK Response.
TestRuntimeMuLargeSSECompressionAndReplay passes 74520 raw SSE bytes through the actual bounded bridge and SDK, verifies retained raw receipt, and checks the replay encoder.
gzip_review.bounds: Raw SSE must be at most 2 MiB, encoded acknowledgement at most 64 KiB, and encoded durable fact at most runtimeFactMaxBytes. Incompressible/oversized responses fail conservatively; this is not an unlimited response transport.

verification.additional_evidence: Typed cancellation test checked provider_calls=1. Large SSE test checked 74520 bytes. Host page test passed multibyte and escaped subcases.

limitations: Only the prior six findings and gzip delivery/replay were re-reviewed. No blanket security certification.
No LIVE provider, production credential or production state was used. No formal W14 dispatch/acceptance or 42-step gate was claimed.
Untracked tests/e2e work belongs to another agent and was not changed or included.
